simple: Check Point Threat Exposure Management (Exposure Prioritization & Remediation, formerly Veriti) — part of Check Point Exposure Management: an agentless platform that pulls vulnerability and configuration data from your existing security tools (70+ integrations: firewalls, WAFs, EDR, vulnerability scanners, CNAPP) and safely fixes exposures through those tools — checking business impact before any change, via API or ITSM tickets. Licensed by number of network security controls (firewalls, WAFs) and assets. The Essential package covers Check Point controls only: assessing and hardening firewall settings (switching protections to prevent mode), finding false positives, and vulnerabilities from Wiz, Check Point Endpoint or External Risk Management. Indicator-of-compromise management: adding, changing and removing IoCs on security controls manually and in bulk. Vulnerability prioritization and remediation are in higher packages.
